requiredFindings.title: A missing H is sent to the actor row
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The account record names /Users/name, InitialActor admitted that spelling, and the directory is absent. Item 5 ends on INSTALLATION.ACCOUNT_REFUSED. That detail is the actor row for unequal UIDs, home spelling or bounds, or a changed account. Owner §3 refuses a missing H before any mkdir and does not call it an actor refusal.

requiredFindings.title: An I/O error during the fence wait takes the busy row
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The retained fence descriptor fails flock with an I/O error. Item 11 ends the wait on LEDGER.BUSY_TIMEOUT, PROJECT.BUSY, ledger-busy. FileLock::try_acquire returns that failure as Err, distinct from busy None, and 468 item 6 sends it to HOST.IO_FAILURE with fault cause host-io.

priorFindings.r1: RF-1, RF-2 and RF-3 are closed. RF-4's suffix absence rule matches owner §5. Missing H and a fence-wait I/O error are new row errors.

scope: Law 458c r2: the r1 recheck, doctor report, busy-wait reservation, and positive-absence classification.
